prompts.prompt_preview: A vertical white line splits the screen into two halves against a dark blue background. On the left half, the quadratic formula 'x = (-b ± √[b² - 4ac]) / 2a' appears in white text. On the right half, a white outline of a right-angled triangle appears. Its vertical side is labeled 'a', its horizontal side is labeled 'b', and its hypotenuse is labeled 'c'. Below the triangle, the Pythagorean theorem 'a² + b² = c²' appears in white text. Both sides of the screen remain static.

The screen remains split. On the left side, a yellow rectangle highlights the 'b² - 4ac' part of the quadratic formula. Below the main formula, three small graphs appear in sequence. First, a parabola intersecting the x-axis twice appears for two seconds. Second, it is replaced by a parabola touching the x-axis once, which appears for two seconds. Third, it is replaced by a parabola above the x-axis, not touching it, which appears for two seconds. The right side of the screen remains static.

The screen remains split. The highlight on the left side disappears. On the right side, the label 'a' on the triangle is replaced by the number '3'. The label 'b' is replaced by the number '4'. The formula below the triangle updates step-by-step: first to '3² + 4² = c²', then to '9 + 16 = c²', then to '25 = c²', and finally to '5 = c'. Simultaneously, the label 'c' on the triangle is replaced by the number '5'.

The screen remains split. The left side is static. On the right side, the triangle and formula are replaced by a new animation. Four identical blue right-angled triangles slide in from the corners of the frame. They arrange themselves so their hypotenuses form a tilted inner square, and their outer edges form a larger, axis-aligned square. The animation completes in the first half of the duration and holds static for the second half.

The vertical dividing line dissolves and the content fades out. The screen transitions to a full-screen, realistic photograph of a suspension bridge; a white parabolic curve is drawn over the main suspension cable. After 2.5 seconds, it cross-fades to a realistic photograph of a satellite dish; a white parabolic curve is drawn on its cross-section.
